Name: A little Bigger Original Greenhouse
Author: ursii98
Description:
The greenhouse was made to accommodate:
- 6 iridium sprinklers,
- 6 quality sprinklers and
- 6 truit trees.

I haven't changed any warp point, but i have added one more water source to the greenhouse.
If you have any questions or suggestions for another greenhouse I would love to hear it.

To install:
1. Back-up your original greenhouse somewhere on your pc or rename it to something else. If [u]not[/u] my file will override the original greenhouse.
2. Download the .rar file and unzip it to somewhere (i recommend desktop).
3. Put file Greenhouse.xnb inside the stradew valley -> content -> maps.
4. You are done! Enjoy

P.S.: I have added a cleaned version without the plants and decor, if someone would prefer that.

To install Content Patcher Version:
1. Download the .rar file and unzip it to somewhere.
2. Put the whole file (CP) ALittleBiggerGreenhouse/(CP) ALittleBiggerGreenhoue-CleanedVersion inside the stardew valley -> mods

To use the Content Patcher Version you NEED [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]!
